## Standing operator rules
Goal: split monolithic `ledgerly/api/routes.py` into per-resource routers.

Pause the router split. Higher priority: the dunning email scheduler in ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py sends reminders to customers who already paid. Fix that.

Increasing the Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours was already tried for the duplicate job runs; it made stuck jobs invisible for hours. Ruled out, do not retry.

Run “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” in this exact order, one step at a time:
1. `psql -h db-prod -U payments -d payments -c "CREATE TABLE webhook_cutover_20250308 AS SELECT * FROM webhook_cursors WHERE name='primary';"`
2. `curl -fsS https://payments.example.com/v2/health?cutover=20250308`
3. `kubectl -n payments set image deployment/webhook-v2 webhook-v2=registry.example.com/payments/webhook:v2.8.1`
4. `kubectl -n payments patch service webhook-public -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"webhook","version":"v2"}}}' --type=merge`
5. `kubectl -n payments create job webhook-replay-a --image=registry.example.com/payments/replay:1.4.0 -- - -from=cursor-primary -to=2025-03-08T12:00:00Z`
6. `kubectl -n payments wait --for=condition=complete job/webhook-replay-a --timeout=300s`
7. `kubectl -n payments create job webhook-replay-b --image=registry.example.com/payments/replay:1.4.0 -- - -from=2025-03-08T12:00:01Z -to=cursor-primary`
8. `psql -h db-prod -U payments -d payments -c "SELECT version, last_event_id, replay_gap FROM webhook_delivery_status;"`

Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya.

Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.

Staging exports now go to ledgerly-exports-stg-v2. The old ledgerly-exports-stg bucket is frozen for an audit and must not be written to.

## Recent work
Webhook cutover steps 1–3 succeeded; step 4 is next. Idempotency race fix committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`; 126 tests passed, 3 skipped. Invoice pagination work is incomplete: schema and service pagination were added, but the route still needs to return `{items,total,limit,offset}` and calculate total; route test currently fails (8 passed, 1 failed).
